source.name: FOX 26 Houston – 'Introducing Shell Energy Stadium: Houston Dynamo, Dash home gets new name'
source.quote: According to a source, Shell Energy’s naming rights contract with the Dynamo and Dash is eight years for $40 million, with an average annual value of $5 million.
source.note: The deal covers the stadium shared with the NWSL Houston Dash. SportsPro and Sports Business Journal reported at announcement that no length or value had been disclosed; the eight-year/$40m figure is FOX 26's, from a single unnamed source ('A Dynamo official declined comment on the terms'). Shell Energy is the energy brand of Shell plc (UK), the sponsor's owner in data/owners/shell-plc.json.
